package.name: race_auv_camera_pkg
package.description: Camera + per-camera AprilTag detector + multi-camera AprilTag fuser. This package ships the Python executables (apriltag_detector_node, apriltag_fuser_node) and their shared private modules (URDF parser, geometry helpers, image processing). All configuration lives in race_auv_bringup/config/ and all launch files in race_auv_bringup/launch/include/.
